The retaining element (12; 42) is biased towards the closed position. Also, a supporting module (1) has at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40) and a stamping machine (100) includes a supporting module (1) or at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40). A method for loading and unloading a reel (2) of stamping foil (3) with such at least one foil reel mounting device (10; 40) is also disclosed.

outputs.L3:
A foil reel mounting device is provided for supporting a reel of stamping foil in a supporting module. The device is designed to hold the reel securely during use while also allowing the reel to be loaded and removed in a simple and reliable manner.

The mounting device includes a support having a recess configured to receive an axle of the stamping foil reel. When the reel is placed in the supporting module, the axle is positioned in the recess so that the reel can be carried by the support. This arrangement allows the reel to be properly located and supported during operation of the stamping machine.

A retaining element is associated with the support and is movable between two positions. In a closed position, the retaining element retains the axle within the recess, thereby preventing the reel from being unintentionally released from the support. In an open position, the retaining element allows the axle to be removed from or inserted into the recess, enabling loading or unloading of the stamping foil reel.

The retaining element is biased toward the closed position. This biasing action helps ensure that, once the reel axle is received in the recess, the retaining element tends to return to or remain in the closed position, thereby improving the security and stability of the reel mounting. The bias may be provided by a spring or another suitable biasing mechanism.

The disclosure further relates to a supporting module equipped with such a foil reel mounting device, as well as to a stamping machine including the supporting module. In addition, a method is provided for loading and unloading a reel of stamping foil using the mounting device. The method may include moving the retaining element to the open position, inserting or removing the reel axle relative to the recess, and allowing or causing the retaining element to return to the closed position so that the axle is securely retained during operation.
outputs.L4:
A foil reel mounting device is provided for receiving and supporting a stamping foil reel, such as a reel used in a foil stamping, hot-stamping, embossing, printing, or sheet-processing machine. The device is designed to hold the reel securely during operation while permitting quick and convenient loading and unloading when a reel must be installed, removed, or replaced.

The mounting device includes a fixed support member having a recess configured to receive an axle or shaft of the foil reel. The recess may be shaped as a seat, cradle, notch, or bearing portion sized to accommodate the reel axle and to support the weight of the reel during use. In order to retain the axle in the recess, the device further includes a movable retaining element mounted relative to the fixed support. This retaining element is biased, for example by a spring or another resilient element, toward a closed or retaining position.

The movable retaining element is shiftable between at least two positions. In an open position, the retaining element is moved away from the axle-receiving recess so that the axle of the foil reel can be inserted into or removed from the recess. In a closed position, the retaining element at least partially obstructs the opening of the recess, thereby preventing the axle from unintentionally escaping from the fixed support. The biasing force urges the retaining element into the closed position, so that once the reel axle is placed in the recess, the retaining element automatically or semi-automatically secures the axle.

During loading, an operator may move the retaining element against the biasing force to expose the recess, place the reel axle into the recess, and then release the retaining element. The retaining element then returns toward its closed position and holds the axle in place. During unloading, the operator again moves the retaining element into the open position, allowing the axle to be lifted or withdrawn from the support. This arrangement simplifies reel replacement while reducing the risk of accidental disengagement during operation.

The device may be used as part of a foil reel supporting module, for example a module that carries one or more supply reels or take-up reels for stamping foil. It may also be integrated into a stamping machine or associated processing equipment. By combining a fixed axle support with a biased movable retainer, the mounting device provides both reliable operational security and improved accessibility for maintenance, setup, and reel exchange.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a foil reel mounting device used in a stamping machine, including the support, recess, biased retaining element, supporting module, stamping machine, and loading/unloading method.
counterfactuals.output: A foil reel mounting device for a stamping machine is disclosed. The device includes a support configured to receive and support a foil reel, the support having a recess for accommodating a portion of the reel or a reel shaft. A retaining element is arranged at or adjacent the recess and is biased toward a retaining position to releasably hold the reel in the recess during operation. The retaining element is movable against the bias to permit insertion or removal of the reel. A supporting module including the foil reel mounting device may be mounted in or to a stamping machine to supply foil to a stamping station. In use, a foil reel is loaded by moving the reel into the recess, whereupon the biased retaining element automatically or resiliently engages the reel to retain it. The reel is unloaded by displacing the retaining element from the retaining position and withdrawing the reel from the recess. The arrangement enables rapid tool-less loading and unloading of foil reels while maintaining reliable support during stamping operation.

The retaining element is movable between the locking position, in which the retaining element engages or blocks the axle to retain the foil reel on the support, and a release position, in which the axle is permitted to enter or be removed from the recess.
